comment: Martin was a great teacher. You are only graded on six short journal entries, two presentations, two essays, and one final project. Achieving an A in this class was not hard at all. Take Martin if you can!

Great FYS professor! Had him twice and he was so kind and helpful when it came to writing. Offered good feedback and was encouraging. Highly enjoys participation and class discussion. Easily one of my favorite professors.

Martin is one of the best teachers I have had at UR because his classes are interesting and fun. There were a few group projects but mostly easy individual work/individual homework. As long as you do the assignments and participate in class, you will do great as he wants his students to learn and succeed!

Martin is an amazing professor and a great man. Arabic is really the first language I've really attempted to learn and despite being Arabic, he makes the class easy and fun. He's more of a learn the material versus get the good grade kind of guy and I respect him a lot for it. Teachers nowadays should take from his example. That is how you teach!

Martin is an amazing professor. His class is super easy to do well in with just a couple super low pressure presentations. He is super accessible outside of class and is very understanding with work. If you have the chance take his class even if it isn't related to what you are interested in.

Martin is the most genuine professor Ive ever come across. Hes extremely receptive to students needs and literally gave us the option to choose our own due dates so that our workloads could be more manageable. He does his best to make the content interesting as well. Im so glad I took his class, hes the man.

I love this man. If it weren't for him I wouldn't be where I am today. Dr. Martin Sulzer-Reichel is overqualified and too smart to be teaching at this University. Someone needs to send that guy to an IVY or make him a Dean ASAP!

Martin is a really nice professor who doesn't demand too much from his students. He never assigns much homework, and his discussion topics are always really interesting. HOWEVER, don't take his class if you're looking to learn something new or challenge yourself intellectually. He does't have any clear course material, so it's kinda a waste of time

Martin is one of the best professors at UofR. Although Arabic is  a tough language to learn, he explains everything very well and he is accessible outside of class for extra help. Even though he helps students a lot, he expects you to make an effort as well. He treats us like adults, so he really appreciates when students are responsible.

It's Arabic, so it's not exactly a walk in the park, but Martin does a good job explaining and reexplaining as needed.  Deadlines/attendance are more guidelines than rules, but if you don't try, don't expect to pass.   If you want to learn Arabic, take Martin, but take the class seriously.  He makes it as easy as possible, but that isn't an easy A.

Martin was the best language teacher I've ever had! He really cared about our understanding of the topic and was always available for extra help. He allows re-takes on tests and quizzes that you don't do well on, so everyone gets a good grade

Very easy. Very nice. Very clear. You will like him. And if you ever need help with anything he will help you. He also teaches very interesting classes in English sometimes, and is one of the best facilitators of discussion out there. Very impressive professor. Among the top professors at this university, I think.

Martin is a great guy...it's too bad that I did not feel prepared enough to take German 202 next semester.  If he were going to be teaching it, I would take it, but it was just so much material and none of it sunk in.  He just couldn't really connect.  The tests and exam were take home though, so that was nice.
Amazing teacher. Always happy and very helpful. Enjoys teaching and will help you in whatever way he can.

What a great guy, but i wish he were strickter in class so that people learned more. Gives lots of extra credit, so if u get above 70% on everything, thats an A. Makes you like the language even though its not an easy one.But does not prepare you for 201 well since it gets much harder
hes awesome. very nice. great person. bu thats as far as it goes. if u want to learn something, dont take his course. too easy, doesnt push you. classes have no structure. but once again, hes awesome

Oh martin... Honestly one of the best german teachers i've ever had. when you get back his tests its literally a sea of red but takes off maybe a half point for mistakes. definitely my favorite class here. study for vocab but not for too long.. theres no need. exams are easy if you have a grasp on the language and pay attention in class.

Such a jolly guy. The intro arabic class was very, very easy... you hardly had to do homework, and weekly vocab quizzes were bearable. All tests and exams are take-home and even though they're hard, they're not timed and you can collaborate with classmates. Easy class, GREAT teacher. Highly recommended overall.
Best Language teacher ive ever had. I hated arabic but he made it bearable. Id recommend him to anyone.
Nicest prof at UR! He is so kind and it is clear that his number one priority is ensuring student success! Sehr gut!

He is just a great person in general. Really cares about his students. If you feel he is moving to fast, you can just talk to him about it and he will slow down. Always willing to help. Good with live advice. Again, amazing professor! Like a fun uncle; you sometimes just want to hug him.
He is really a jolly guy and the class is very very easy.

Nicest teacher I've ever had, and is good at explaining things so they are understandable.  If anything his classes are almost too easy; he's so lenient with grades that his class sometimes will take a backseat to more demanding courses.  If you want to learn a language, and can work  without needing someone to watch over you, take his class.
Martin rocks.  If you need a language requirement but don't wanna do anything, take him.

Martin is the nicest guy and most enjoyable professor. First class ever that I look forward to going and am sad when I have to leave. He cares more about us learning the material than anything else and makes grading such that worrying about grades never interferres with class or the subject in general.

Martin is so nice! The only homework is a weekly summary of what you talked about in class, which he lets you correct and turn in super late. He can be a bit unclear when assigning projects but he answers e-mails quickly and is always willing to help. His class is sometimes boring but he never tests you on the material so that's a plus!
Martin is the big, smoking teddy bear!  We love you Martin!
He is really helpful outside of class. He is one of the nicest individuals I ever came across in my life. He is pretty easy going and he cares about his students.
martin is the man

An extremely nice guy..yet extremely boring in class. Very nice, but not born to be a teacher. As a Germ major I wanted a better perfomence in class, but obviously he does not have the talent to run it. I dropped his  Germ 311, could not stand it, and took instead Bower, the hardest prof ever!
really nice guy, but the pace of the class is crazy.  sometimes it's really slow, other times you really have to try hard to keep up
The nicest guy ever, and such a great professor

Super nice guy and fun to talk to out of class.  Sometimes seems lost as a teacher though and can be a little unclear for those who don't know german well yet, but he's always willing to slow down and help you out.
Herr Sulzer-Reichel is the coolest teacher. Very helpful and very patient.
He knows his German (he's a native) and conducts a good class.
